record.current_corrections: Closure occurred on 11 December 2022, but first restoration remains contested: Reuters reports Sunday reopening after several hours, Arab News describes Monday trade return, and Al Jazeera frames Tuesday reopening while its official quote establishes normal status that day. Bounds 11–13 December retain the conflict; no numeric or same-day duration is admitted and no uninterrupted two-day closure is asserted.

record.rationale_phase_note: The clash and temporary interruption are reported, but an agreed closure rationale and responsible initiating actor are not established. Competing accusations are not converted into a single official rationale.
